Mountain State Wheelers Saturday Ride

Charleston, WV · Road

Mountain State Wheelers Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Charleston, WV. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am. Pace: a/B/C categories (6–18 mph).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 6–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Mountain State Wheelers Saturday Ride group ride

The Charleston area road club's Saturday ride. Start point and route change each week on a published schedule, with Elkview, Winfield, Milton and Alum Creek regulars. Ride categories run from beginner to advanced.
